basic_profile.bio: Avid reader and history enthusiast residing in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a data analyst for a tech company, but my evenings are often spent curled up with a good book or exploring new hiking trails with my German Shepherd, Max. I have a keen interest in narratives centered around societal change and ideologies, which often leads me to both fiction and non-fiction works about revolutions. Despite my love for intense themes, I indulge in lighter entertainment like marble runs to unwind. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people through book clubs and local community events. Typically active on Reddit during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in data analytics and historical literature. I have a degree in history with a focus on modern revolutions, and I've continuously expanded my knowledge through both structured courses and self-guided learning. My professional role in analytics allows me to approach historical data with a critical eye, often blending my work skills with my personal interests.
